title: winspace g3 - this build was no fun

takeaways.text: The L-Twoo electronic rear derailleur's power cable to the seatpost battery would not pass through the chainstay; after two days and sanding the connector, the system did not work. The owner returned that groupset (full refund) and fitted L-Twoo mechanical shifting instead.
With mechanical shifting fully internal the owner reported flawless shifting and a confident first ride, but said he would avoid fully internal routing next time because building it was so slow.

disclosure: The creator's own first bike build; the description mentions no sponsorship or supplied product.
summary: First home build of a G3 that turned difficult when an electronic groupset's power cable would not pass through the chainstay; the owner switched to a mechanical groupset and reports the finished bike riding well.
